title: Same Office, Same Bank Relationship, Different Money Rails
scope: Negative-finding review of whether Southern Trust technology-investment funds can be traced into the 2006 Butterfly Trust beneficiary-payment rail.

sources.supports: FBI Senior Financial Investigator characterization of Butterfly as a possible conduit based on SAR/FinCEN material.
sources.limit: The email itself warns SARs contain unsubstantiated allegations; named native PPTX/XLSX attachments are not recovered.

sources.supports: More than 120 wires totaling $2.65M from Butterfly and various other Epstein accounts to Butterfly beneficiaries; stated purposes included hotel, tuition, rent.
sources.limit: Mixed-account beneficiary aggregate; not every beneficiary is classified as a victim.

sources.supports: 2006 Butterfly formation; Epstein grantor; Indyke and Kahn trustees.
sources.limit: Trust instrument does not identify later transaction-by-transaction signers.

sources.supports: Southern Financial Relationship and Stewart Oldfield relationship-manager identification; Butterfly within relationship KYC.
sources.limit: Relationship-level evidence is not same-account evidence.

sources.supports: Butterfly deposit account ending 0552; Deutsche Bank operational record also lists Southern Trust accounts separately.
sources.limit: Operational grouping does not establish transfers between listed accounts.

sources.supports: Southern Trust MMDA ending 9244; $20M Honeycomb Partners wire.
sources.limit: One technology-investment transaction; does not identify Butterfly as recipient.

sources.supports: Southern Trust $1M Reporty investment to ERGO; From-line identifies Darren.
sources.limit: Does not establish any downstream beneficiary-payment use.

sources.supports: Recovered Butterfly transaction extract used for cross-entity search.
sources.limit: Extract is incomplete; absence of tech strings is a recovered-record negative, not proof of universal absence.

sources.supports: Cross-domain account/entity/person/bank reconciliation and completeness assessment.
sources.limit: Archive-created synthesis; controlling claims remain tied to primary records above.

open_questions: Whether the missing FinCEN flow-of-funds presentation and spreadsheet can be recovered.
Whether unusable JPMorgan wire workbooks contain additional cross-entity transfers.
Whether missing statement periods change the negative transaction-chain result.
Which human operator authorized or signed each individual beneficiary wire.
not_established: A Southern Trust or technology-investment proceeds chain into the 2006 Butterfly payment rail.
A shared bank account between Southern Trust and the 2006 Butterfly Trust.
That every Butterfly beneficiary was a victim.
Money laundering, layering, conspiracy or facilitation from the documented administrative overlap.
